page.overview:
Who is Bessie?

Bessie is the name of a cow belonging to Sammy Gutierrez, and she is considered Sammy's favorite cow.

When unconscious from the Scorpios rex's poison, Sammy Gutierrez mentions Bessie after mistaking the noises Kenji made for the cow. Kenji then pretends to be Bessie in order to calm Sammy down in her drugged state.

Sammy brings up Bessie to Darius and Ben asking if they remember her. It is also mentioned that Bessie had a calf at some point.
